about: Glyph set v0 for Relic spellcraft. Templates live in a roughly [-1,1] box with Y up. A stroke is a list of [x,y] points and {"arc":[cx,cy,rx,ry,fromDeg,toDeg]} pieces (degrees counter-clockwise from +X). See Assets/Relic/Magic/README.md.

glyphs.name: Water
glyphs.hint: A droplet: one stroke from a point at the top around a round bottom and back.

glyphs.name: Flame
glyphs.hint: Three flame tongues, one zigzag stroke: low peak, tall peak in the middle, low peak. No base.

glyphs.name: Stone
glyphs.hint: A mountain: a closed triangle pointing up, with a line across its middle.

glyphs.name: Wind
glyphs.hint: Three gusts: horizontal strokes, the top one curling up at its right end.

glyphs.name: Light
glyphs.hint: A five-pointed star in one stroke, starting and ending at the top point.

glyphs.name: Growth
glyphs.hint: A sprouting fern: a stem that curls over at the top, plus a small leaf low on the left.

glyphs.name: More
glyphs.hint: A plus sign. More damage.

glyphs.name: Less
glyphs.hint: A chevron pointing down. A smaller, cheaper, quicker spell.

glyphs.name: Far
glyphs.hint: An arrow pointing up and to the right. Longer range, wider areas.

glyphs.name: Lasting
glyphs.hint: An infinity loop, one stroke. Statuses and areas last longer.

glyphs.name: Split
glyphs.hint: A fork (Y). The first Split makes more projectiles; more Splits make them burst on impact.

glyphs.name: Seek
glyphs.hint: An eye: an upper and a lower arc meeting at the corners, with a small pupil.

glyphs.name: Heavy
glyphs.hint: A triangle pointing down, one closed stroke. Bigger and harder-hitting, but slower.

glyphs.name: Swift
glyphs.hint: Two chevrons pointing right (>>). Faster projectiles.

glyphs.name: Line
glyphs.hint: A horizontal line with a short upright tick at each end. Bolts fired where you aim.

glyphs.name: Cone
glyphs.hint: A fan: a wedge opening to the right, closed by an arc.

glyphs.name: Ring
glyphs.hint: A small circle. Projectiles burst out in every direction.

glyphs.name: Wall
glyphs.hint: A battlement: one square-wave stroke, up, across, down, across, up, across, down. Needs a Line next to it.

glyphs.name: Orbit
glyphs.hint: A spiral: one stroke winding out from the middle, about a turn and a quarter.

glyphs.name: Return
glyphs.hint: A hook: up, over the top and down, ending in an arrowhead. Projectiles come back.

glyphs.name: Delay
glyphs.hint: An hourglass: one closed stroke, top bar, diagonal, bottom bar, diagonal. Everything after it on the ring waits.
